notes.title: New Release!
notes.content:
After four years since this game was released, I finally show my new game here!

The name is VDoll.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122110/]> VDoll store page [/url]

Compared to the previous game, VDoll has the following features.

[olist]
[*]Improvement of female characters.
[*]The female body can be moved more freely owing to the physics engine.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890627/686b4b2ae15b386fb30687519c709b53bb38a560.png[/img]

It should be more realistic and prettier than LoveRoom.

Of course, like LoveRoom, VDoll has a VR mode and a character creation system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890627/b17fe2aaa329a167ccd90c00e931e17257b0be34.gif[/img]

It uses the physics engine, so you can move the female body as you like. If you play with VR, you can enjoy the flexibility to the fullest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890627/63f963eb3ce9869205d4c3100d2721c28f925c49.gif[/img]

As a side note, LoveRoom is made with Unity, but VDoll is Unreal Engine 5.

[h1]Release Date [/h1]

I plan to release on 11th November as Early Access.
Don’t forget to put it on your wish list.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122110/]> VDoll store page [/url]

[h1]The developer name is changed [/h1]
At the release of VDoll, I changed the developer name as follows.

Magnabokan  ->  FoxPunch

FoxPunch is cuter, isn’t it?

See you!

notes.title: Published beta
notes.content:
I' m releasing a test version of the game with improved graphics quality as a beta.
Please note that many features are missing in this version, including VR.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890627/e7bed8ddf1f7df68ae31a6f2e612cd2460788d9a.jpg[/img]

[h1]How to activate a beta version?[/h1]

Please follow the steps below.

1. Open the game property
2. Open the beta tab
3. Input access code "betabetabeta"
4. Select 'beta'
5. Wait for downloading

[h1]What features are missing compared to the default version (v1.32) ?[/h1]

A. Cannot enable VR. Desktop version only.
B. Cannot fire the fluid
C. Skirt cloth simulation is disabled
D. Hair shading is unnatural

[h1]What is "Development Build" in the bottom right corner?[/h1]

This is because there is a bug in Unity that prevents screen captures from being taken, which is resolved when the development build is turned on. So, I'm releasing a temporary development build version.

[h1]Plans for the future?[/h1]

The reason for lack points [A] and [B] shown in (2) is that libraries developed by other companies do not support Unity's HDRP currently.
After each library supports HDRP, these problems will be resolved and then I'll release in a default version.

[h1]I found the limitations of the current development environment[/h1]

I've been working on a series of recent updates and I found the limitations of this application.

Unity has been steadily adding features. Excellent. However, since UnrealEngine appears to be more powerful at the moment, the desire to develop in UnrealEngine is growing.
Also, there is little room for improvement in the current female models. What I'm thinking about now is that DazStudio will allow me to create models that are more realistic and allow for more detailed body and facial adjustments.
As a result of thinking about these two points, I felt a growing desire to use the knowledge I gained from this development to create a new, better application.

[h1]From now on...[/h1]

In the future, I plan to update this application as needed to make up for the lack of features shown in (3), and when the lack of features is made up, the development will be completed. At the same time, I would like to develop new applications.
I apologize to those of you who were hoping for the development of this application, but please stay tuned as I will be able to make a better application.

notes.title: Version 1.32
notes.content:
Sorry for the long wait.
I have updated what I wanted to fix and published it as v1.32.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Removed the splash screen with Unity logo when start the game.
[*]Correcting the lighting that must change with facial and body adjustments. (Recalculating normal vectors)
[*]Added shadows around the eyes to make the face look more natural.
[*]Removed the censoring effect when she wears. (If uncensored patch was not downloaded)
[*]Set the reflection probe. The lighting has been modified to look softer.
[*]Set the sky texture. (Set the skybox)
[/list]

[h1]About the problem of not being able to launch in some environments[/h1]
Recently, I knew the following problem: Unity application and Steam DRM are not compatible. The game wouldn't run in some environments.
From current version, I didn't apply Steam DRM, so if you couldn't start the game before, you may be able to start it now.

[h1]For those who have been applying IL2CPP beta[/h1]
From the current version, the compiler has been unified as mono instead of IL2CPP.
IL2CPP was an option for those who couldn't launch the app, but it was found that the cause of the inability to run would be DRM.
Therefore, if you have applied the IL2CPP beta, please deactivate it.
You can set it up in the Beta tab of the application options.

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
Recently, Unity HDRP can be used with VR application.
It means that the graphics will be better.
I'm interested in it, so I want to try this.
However, it can fail. Please don't expect too much.

notes.title: Version 1.31 - Bug Fix
notes.content:
It seems that the game couldn't save character properties correctly in some environment.
When saving character properties file, real number is exported with comma (,) in some countries.

e.g.
1.345 <- Real number with dot (I expected)
1,345 <- Real number with comma

So the game can't read number because it can't distinguish comma in number and separator.
As a result, the game failed to parse character file.
From this version (v1.31), the game save properties not as real number but as integer.

Of course, you can import existing character.

notes.content:
I know that this game crashes when exiting sometimes.
It seems that this bug exists from v1.18 (01/14/2018).
On v1.18, I switched the build method from 'mono' to 'il2cpp'.
The reason why I switched is that 'il2cpp' is more compatible than 'mono'.
However, it seems that 'il2cpp' is unstable for this game.
So from this version (v1.25), I decided to switch back to 'mono' and publish 'il2cpp' version as a beta (You can select in BETAS tab).

If the game doesn't start at all, try 'il2cpp' beta.
Please see instruction in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/975760/discussions/0/1744479063996851539/]this FAQ[/url].

[h1]Other changes[/h1]
Many players couldn't notice how to save and load, so I added instruction text about save and load menu.

notes.title: To HTC Vive users
notes.content:
This game uses SteamVR, so you can play with 'Oculus Rift' or 'HTC Vive'.
To get controller input, it uses 'SteamVR Input'. 'SteamVR Input' is the system to customize button bindings and share those. It started in May of this year.
However, I don't have budget to buy 'HTC Vive', so I made a SteamVR Input bindings file for vive controller by text editor. Therefore, it might not work correctly. If vive controller doesn't work well, please customize that setting on your own or report errors to this board. I will fix it as soom as possible.

To open setting bindings page of SteamVR Input, [b]first run SteamVR[/b], then access this url (http://127.0.0.1:8998/dashboard/controllerbinding.html). (Settings of this game might not appear if you haven't run this game before.)
Default bindings file (This is the file I made) for vive controller is "bindings_vive_controller.json" in local directory of this game.

Below image is a bindings setting for Oculus Touch controller. If you want to modify a setting for vive controller, this will help.

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890627/d7ede6cd3fb79c5c81491de3c6215bb48af516f3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890627/82bcf40713e51f36abfd2727f2cd4e3cfc25cd24.png[/img][/url]
